sense: a young person, not yet grown up

pins.definition: A male child, or (especially in the plural) a young person of either sex.
A young human who is not yet an adult.
A young human being who is not yet an adult; a son or daughter of any young age.

situation: A small boy stands on his tiptoes in a kitchen, holding a wooden spoon up to reach the counter.
